steps: Drop the washed spinach into boiling water for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted, then lift it straight into cold water.
Drain the spinach well and blend it with the ginger, garlic and green chilli to a smooth paste.
Heat the oil on medium and let the cumin seeds and bay leaf sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and fry, stirring often, until golden.
Add the tomato and cook until it turns soft and oil shows at the edges.
Turn the heat down and stir in the turmeric, chilli powder and garam masala for half a minute.
Add the spinach paste, about 30 ml water a person and the salt, and simmer on medium-low for 6 to 8 minutes, until it thickens.
Add the paneer cubes, cream and crushed kasuri methi, stir for a minute and turn off the heat.
note: Spinach ranged from 45 to 90 g a serving across the sources; 75 g gives a thick green gravy. Onion and tomato are higher than before to match two of the three sources.
